7z GUI Linux  - Nightly Builds

Github | Issues | Discussions

7z-GUI-Linux is a simple GUI for 7-zip on Linux based operating systems. It doesn't require any dependency to run (other than 7z). It is based on the '7-zip for Windows'.

This page including the Nightly Builds below are built using GitHub Actions.
Please use GitHub Release to get the latest stable version as the versions here can be unstable.

Leave a star on GitHub if you like this project!

To install 7z GUI Linux on your system, follow these steps:

  1. Download latest release from below.
  2. Extract the archive. You should now have the `7z-GUI-Linux` file.
  3. Simply make `7z-GUI-Linux` executable => right click `7z-GUI-Linux`, go to Properties, and in the Permissions tab, tick 'Make executable'
  4. Double click `7z-GUI-Linux` to launch!
